fact_text: The National Finance Commission (NFC) award is the formula by which the federal government shares its tax revenue with the provinces.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The federal divisible pool under the NFC covers income tax, capital value tax, sales tax, federal excise duty and customs duty; non-tax federal revenue is not shared.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Article 160 of the Constitution lists the shareable taxes and lets the president add more, and the 18th Amendment bars any cut in the provinces' share.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The speaker said provinces receive 58% of federal tax collection under the NFC award as of the video date, while the 2009 award set the share at 56%.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The seventh NFC award, agreed in 2009, set the provinces' share at 56%, and the constitutional floor means later awards cannot go below that level.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The federal government collected about 12 trillion PKR of taxes in fiscal 2024-25, according to the speaker.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: About 7 trillion PKR of federal taxes in fiscal 2024-25 went to the provinces under the NFC award.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: Population carries 82% of the NFC formula weight, the largest share, with poverty, own tax collection and inverse population density as the other criteria.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The federal government argues that after provincial transfers little is left to meet its own expenditure, and it wants the sharing formula changed.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The federal government argues that a population-based formula gives provinces little reason to curb population growth, so it wants the formula revised.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)

fact_text: The federal government and the provinces were set to meet to seek consensus on changing the NFC formula.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'The NFC Award Explained in Under 6 Minutes | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-12-02)
